_what: The recorded identity of the deployed artifact. Gates read the namespace from here rather than restating it, so a gate cannot compare a constant with itself.
_module_hash_note: MEASURED on chain, never computed locally. A Pact 5 module hash covers its dependencies' hashes, and the test suite loads a vendored coin snapshot while mainnet runs a different coin — so a locally computed hash will never equal this and proves nothing. VERIFY.md §1 compares the CODE instead.

block_record._note: The contract pins this by hash in its `use`, so it cannot silently settle from a different record.
